published_gap_rule.meaning: No Brownian bridge across successive GPS gaps >12.5h; not ecological dispersal impossibility.

observation_order: Frozen source-blind T0 lower/upper/DBF ordinal order in Herd×AID×SeasnYr×Season
clock_reference: Naive local Mountain wall-clock seconds; no UTC or DST conversion

segmentation_arms.optimistic: Keep edge whenever any pairwise time assignment fits [1,45000]s; split all other edges
segmentation_arms.coherent: Propagate one reachable time interval per contiguous segment; split and reset at first impossible extension
segmentation_arms.conservative: Keep edge only when every clock assignment for the two consecutive windows fits [1,45000]s

aggregate_metrics: retained edges, cuts, total segments, segments >=2 records
extra coherent cuts versus optimistic and number of affected source groups
full-group pairwise-only false chains and effective time segment counts
controls: optimistic segments <= coherent segments <= conservative segments
2-record and 3-record counts must recover frozen PR #748 and PR #749 receipts
independent exhaustive small-clock partition enumeration validates greedy segmentation
no raw GPS IDs, exact times or coordinate values in output
